newsitem.title: USA: NAL Financial has liquidity problems.
newsitem.headline: NAL Financial has liquidity problems.

text.p: NAL Financial Group Inc said Friday that it is facing a material liquidity issue and is evaluating alternatives involving its sale or financial recapitalization.
NAL said that if it were unsuccessful in concluding a sale or recapitalization, it might have to consider other alternatives, including reorganization.

The company also said that it has applied for a five-day extension for the filing of its quarterly report on Form 10-Q for the period ended June 30, 1997 and expects to release additional data regarding its second quarter earnings and performance in conjunction with this filing.
Earlier it reported a second quarter loss of $0.63 per share compared with a year-earlier profit of $0.29.
